$comment: The source of sf-input-date's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/datepicker (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs from simai/ui-source@5100227 src/smart/datepicker/smart.manifest.json); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Its x-todo are decided in x-decisions.

date.summary: The value chosen, in the mode's ISO form: yyyy-mm-dd (date), yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm (datetime) or hh:mm (time); value is read only when date is absent, so date="" is a cleared value.

start-value.summary: Range only: the ISO start date.

end-value.summary: Range only: the ISO end date.

max-date.summary: The latest ISO date that can be chosen; later days are disabled. In datetime mode it may carry a time (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm), the latest time on that day.

min-date.summary: The earliest ISO date that can be chosen; earlier days are disabled. In datetime mode it may carry a time (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm), the earliest time on that day.

mode.summary: What is chosen: a date (the calendar), a date and a time (the calendar and the time row under it) or a time of day alone (the time row). The value is yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm or hh:mm, the wall clock as the host writes it.

min-time.summary: datetime and time: the earliest time of day that can be chosen, hh:mm.

max-time.summary: datetime and time: the latest time of day that can be chosen, hh:mm.

minute-step.summary: datetime and time: the minutes a step moves, 1 to 60, counted from the hour; a typed time off the step is not taken.

range.summary: Pick a start and an end instead of one date; date mode only.

month.summary: The month shown when the panel opens, 0-11; defaults to the chosen date's month, else the current one.

year.summary: The year shown when the panel opens; defaults to the chosen date's year, else the current one.

context.summary: Which grid the panel opens on: days (empty), month or year.

week-start.summary: The first day of the week, 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday (1 Monday). Without the attribute it follows the page's language (ru: Monday, en-US: Sunday, ar-EG: Saturday).

locale.summary: The language of month and day names; defaults to the page language.

format.summary: How the value is shown in the field and read when typed, e.g. DD.MM.YYYY: the whole text one value, a four-digit year from 1000 to 9999, HH hours (00-23) and mm minutes. The default follows the mode: DD.MM.YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm, HH:mm; a date format given to datetime mode gets « HH:mm». The value stays ISO.

close-on-select.summary: Close the panel once a date (or a range end) is chosen.

input.summary: Draw the text field; without it only the panel is drawn.

portal.summary: Draw the panel at the end of the document so no clipping ancestor cuts it.

input-type.summary: The field's appearance (bordered by default), as on sf-inputs.

input-size.summary: Legacy name for size, still honoured; size wins when both are set. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

input-name.summary: The form field name of the value; wins over name.

disabled.summary: Disable the field and the panel.

required.summary: Mark the field required in its form.

invalid.summary: Draw the field invalid: the error border and aria-invalid on the native input. Removing it restores the valid field.

error-message.summary: The message under an invalid field; ignored while the field is valid.

hint.summary: The helper text under the field, read to the control as its description, as on sf-input. An error-message takes its place while the field is invalid and it comes back when invalid is removed.

icon-start.summary: The icon at the start of the field; the canonical name for left-icon. Defaults to calendar_today, schedule in time mode.

left-icon.summary: Legacy name for icon-start, still honoured; icon-start wins when both are set.

hint-icon.summary: The marker at the end of the field, as on sf-input; it stays while the field is invalid.

input-root-class.summary: Classes added to the field's root.

mask.summary: Mask what can be typed in the field to the format.

mask-pattern.summary: Input mask; when not set it is derived from format, so the default format DD.MM.YYYY gives 00.00.0000.

mask-lazy.summary: Show the mask's placeholder characters only as they are typed.

mask-placeholder-char.summary: The character that stands for a position not yet typed.

mask-options.summary: Further mask options as JSON, passed to the field's mask.

name.summary: The form field name of the value. input-name is the same and wins when both are set.

preset.summary: The chosen quick range's id. Set by a host it wins over start-value and end-value, and a relative one is resolved against today in the person's time zone when drawn; nothing is emitted for it.

readonly.summary: Keeps the field read-only: the date is chosen on the grid only. A single date can be typed by default; a range is always chosen on the grid.

presets.summary: Quick ranges, range mode only; the attribute keeps its comma list of built-in ids

value.summary: The value in the mode's ISO form: yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm (datetime) or hh:mm (time). As a property, [start, end] for a range (two ISO dates, "" for an end not chosen yet). The attribute is the initial value: once it is cleared it stays empty.

change.summary: A date, a time or a range endpoint was chosen; dispatched on the host. The name to bind.

open-panel.summary: Open the popup; optionally move focus into the calendar.

close-panel.summary: Close the popup; optionally restore focus to the field.

toggle-panel.summary: Toggle the popup without changing the selected value.

choose-preset.summary: Choose a quick range: set its dates, show the month it ends in and emit change once.

choose-custom-range.summary: Let go of the quick range and move focus to the grid.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §16.20). Event rows send the new name first, then the old one, with one detail; setting rows map the old attribute and property to the new; host-attribute rows (no "to") stay host attributes read by the browser or the base and are listed, refused by the shim on purpose; documentary rows ("shim": "none") record a rename the shim cannot serve.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
sent by the shim after change, with the same detail; the detail no longer carries the element (§8)
rows.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

rows.note: sent by the shim after change, with the same detail; the detail no longer carries the element (§8)
rows.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

rows.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
rows.note: the element is sf-input-date; sf-datepicker is a subclass defined beside it until the date

x-summary: Accessible date, date-and-time, time and date-range picker with popup and inline presentation, calendar and time navigation and host-owned values.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
x-decisions: assembly: it stays a leaf. The one interactive Smart part it places is its own text box (sf-input), wired privately for typing, masks and focus; the grid, the month and year lists and the quick ranges are its own markup. An assembly would declare keys, roles and rules to wire a single text box no rule can reach better than the leaf does (the smaller mechanism)
version: 1.1.0 -- sf-datepicker-change and sf-change follow change behind dated aliases, presets becomes a list, the actions answer outcomes; a minor while the aliases hold (§4.10)
a11y-role: dialog while it opens from its text box; inline (input=false) the panel is a group. The role field takes one value in 1.3.8, so the inline case is written here

key-effects: the text box opens the calendar with ArrowDown and closes it with Escape; in the grid (panel) Left and Right move a day, Up and Down a week (step:-7/+7), Home and End to the week's first and last day, PageUp and PageDown a month, Enter and Space choose
type-union: presets is a list of {id, label?, relative?, range?}; the attribute keeps its comma list of built-in ids
item-shape: value is the date in the ISO form (YYYY-MM-DD); in range mode the property is [start-value, end-value] and the form submits start/end (ISO 8601 interval); the host owns the stored value
template: the default template stays the Lit module js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; template.html follows when the build compiles HTML templates
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and the docs
css-variables: six public variables read by the class sheets with the role as fallback (§6)
side-effects: none -- with portal the panel is positioned as fixed in place; it is never moved to the end of body

form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals (§17.1): the ISO date (a range as start/end), never the display text; nothing while disabled; read-only submits; form.reset() returns the written value without events. The inner sf-input carries no name. value-missing while required and empty
actions: open-panel, close-panel, toggle-panel, choose-preset {item} and choose-custom-range answer outcomes (§4.4)
ids: the panel id comes from the instance path (§7.1.1), not a module counter

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate). The default example now prints the input with its panel relation (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, aria-controls): the snapshot is taken after the element has drawn with its sheets.

version 1.1.4: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.1.5: disabled reaches the whole panel -- every day, month and year, the month and year arrows and toggles, the quick ranges and «Свой период» are disabled and their handlers and the choose-preset and choose-custom-range actions refuse (outcome disabled), so a panel a host holds open, or the inline one, changes no value while the field is disabled; readonly keeps its meaning (no typing, the grid still chooses). The value property is a type union, written in x-registry.inputs.value: an ISO date string, or [start, end] -- what the getter returns in range mode, a real feature (range, start-value, end-value) and not a leftover. The object {start|startValue|date, end|endValue} older callers pass is still read as that pair for compatibility but stays out of the contract; any other shape (a number, a boolean, an object without those keys, a Date) is read as before -- text, or cleared -- with a console warning once per element.

version 1.2.0: hint and hint-icon are settings of sf-datepicker, forwarded to the inner sf-input as every other field setting is -- field parity with sf-input, asked for by the UI Kit thread (2026-10-29). hint is the helper text under the field and the control's description (aria-describedby on the native input); hint-icon is the marker at the field's end. Both are declared as sf-input declares them (string with an empty default; icon with an empty default), so a person sees one behaviour in both fields: an error-message takes the hint's place while the field is invalid and the hint comes back when invalid is removed, and hint-icon stays either way. hint is a word setting (§15.1) with an empty default, so it holds no word of its own and nothing moves to lang. Added settings behind no rename are a minor (§4.10).

text-end: not a setting of sf-datepicker, and not forwarded (dispatcher decision, 2026-10-29). The calendar trigger owns the field's end: the whole field opens the panel, so trailing text would read as part of the value while being a click target that opens a calendar. hint-icon is kept there because it is a marker a reader looks at, not text beside the date. A host that needs a unit or a suffix beside a date uses sf-input.

version 1.3.0: the tag is sf-input-date (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.input-date and the bundle cl-input-date follow it. sf-datepicker stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-input-date, sf-datepicker) (change journal tag-sf-datepicker-to-sf-input-date, path-smart-datepicker-to-input-date).

version 1.4.0: a minor (§4.10, settings added behind no rename): mode (date, datetime, time), min-time, max-time and minute-step (stage 1 of the component sets, duplication audit A-14: sf-view-properties drew its own day-and-time pair, and the field renderers drew one too, because this picker had no clock). datetime puts a time row under the grid and the value is yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm; time draws the time row alone and the value is hh:mm; date is unchanged. The time row is hours and minutes, each an APG spinbutton (ArrowUp/ArrowDown a step, Home/End the first and last allowed, digits typed, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight between the parts, Enter closes the panel) between two steppers out of the tab order, at the control height of size 1 and a day's width each, so it measures in the grid's unit. A day chosen in datetime mode keeps the time shown, or takes the first the day allows, and the panel stays open on the hours. The bounds: min-time and max-time hold every day; in datetime mode min-date and max-date may carry a time, which holds on their own day; minute-step counts from the hour, and a typed time off the step or outside the bounds puts the field back, as a date outside them does. The field reads the whole text in the format (DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm, HH:mm by default) or the ISO form; seconds, a fraction and a zone in a stored value are read past (the host owns the zone) and a change writes the minute. The change detail carries mode and, for datetime and time, time (hh:mm). range is a range of dates and is read in date mode only. Words: time, hours, minutes, the four stepper names, time-not-set and the two value-missing sentences, in ru and en.

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-07): the month and year toggles in the calendar header are size 1/2 instead of size 1 with compact spacing: density no longer changes a button's height (component.buttons 1.4.0, owner rule C01, docs review R022), and 1/2 is as tall as the compact 1 was (32px desktop, 28px phone); their label is the 1/2 text step. Settings, values and events unchanged.

version 1.4.2 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.3: the sf-button and sf-button-icon it draws are asked for their current names (appearance ghost for link, status danger for error; actions block, decisions C13 and C15), so the template uses no dated alias; nothing it draws changes.

version 1.4.4 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The generated reference gives each action's method its one object argument, openPanel({options}), closePanel({options}), choosePreset({item}), where it read the parameters one by one (standard §4.4: the parameters arrive as one object). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.5 (2026-11-09): a patch; nothing in the component changed. The sf-input it draws asks for the kbd sheet since sf-input 1.7.0 (C38, the shortcut setting; component.kbd 1.3.0), so its first-paint snapshots name that sheet and carry one more empty line where the field's shortcut would stand; the component takes a patch with them. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.6 (2026-11-11): the calendar drawn without a field is the flat place of C20 (no overlay shadow, an outline-variant hairline; component.datepicker 1.3.4, docs pre-check 2026-11-10 DP-06): the panel carries sf-datepicker--inline. The popup is unchanged. The field wrapper is top-aligned (component.datepicker 1.3.4): on the text baseline its height followed the calendar icon held at font-size 0 before the icon font, 49 held and 48 loaded at 390. Days off are drawn in on-surface-variant, not the error red (owner decision 2026-11-11, DP-02; component.datepicker 1.3.4); a day off of the next or previous month takes the same ink (it kept the red), and a day off says «выходной» (en «day off») after its date in its name, a new word day-off in ru and en.

item_contract.value_format: ISO values: YYYY-MM-DD in date mode, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm in datetime mode, hh:mm in time mode (the wall clock, no zone); format controls only the visible field value.
item_contract.range_value: Range mode exposes start-value and end-value and restarts the range after a completed selection.

value.description: The value in the mode's ISO form (yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm, hh:mm), or [start, end] for a range; "" when cleared.

range.description: Whether the field picks a range.

formattedValue.description: The value as shown, in format.

date.description: The ISO date; for a range, the ISO 8601 interval start/end (the start alone until the end is chosen).

isoValue.description: The same as date: the ISO date, or for a range the interval start/end.

formattedStartValue.description: Range only: the start as shown.

formattedEndValue.description: Range only: the end as shown.

preset.description: Range only: the quick range chosen, {id, relative} or {id}; null for a range picked on the grid.

mode.description: The mode: date, datetime or time.

time.description: datetime and time only: the time of day, hh:mm; "" for none.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input-date for a single date, a date and a time (mode="datetime"), a time of day (mode="time") or a date range that benefits from calendar or time navigation. Use a plain input when free-form entry is the primary task.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not use color as the only selected or disabled signal
Do not encode timezone or business-date rules in the visual component
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

accessibility.focus: ArrowDown opens the popup and moves focus to the active day. Only one day is in the tab order. Escape closes the popup and restores focus to the field. RTL reverses physical horizontal arrows while preserving chronological movement.

sf-datepicker-change.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

sf-change.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

setContext.summary: Open the day, month or year calendar context.

root-class.description: Classes added to the component's root.

aria-label.description: Accessible name for a date or time field rendered without a visible label.
